spell.description: contributors-to-leads for a repo's contributors, forks-to-leads for a repo's forks, github-to-leads for other GitHub people, attendees-to-leads for an event guest list

source.description: stars: a repo's stargazers; contributors: a repo's contributors; forks: a repo's forks; search: a GitHub user search; users: logins, one per line; csv: a guest list

value.description: owner/repo for stars, contributors and forks, a GitHub search such as 'language:python location:berlin', logins one per line, or the CSV text

min_tier.description: Leave out leads below this tier (default cold)

event.description: The event's name, for guest lists
